name: Gleitring-Systeme Kaltenbrunn AG
summary: Gleitring-Systeme Kaltenbrunn AG is a large, financially stable Swiss group company (900 staff, 247 M EUR turnover, credit index 162 unchanged). It is our sole source for an ATEX, drinking-water-approved cartridge seal, and we are only 0.2 % of its turnover. Head office has frozen all price reductions until December 2027, but the sales director is open on payment terms and call-off flexibility.

situation.decision_maker: Key account manager or sales director within head-office policy. Price changes above 2 % need the pricing committee, which meets every two weeks. Price reductions are blocked by a head-office directive until Dec 2027.

negotiation_pattern: It asks for small annual increases (3.3 %, then 2.2 %, then 1.3 %) and has settled at 0.0 % every time, so it accepts a price hold without a fight. This year it quoted an unchanged 319.11 and refers to policy ('head-office directive') rather than haggling. It defends list price by pointing to the hierarchy and redirects to payment terms and call-off flexibility.
wants: list price integrity (no visible reduction against head-office policy)
reliable, on-time payment (we pay late 66 % of the time)
planning security: forecasts and multi-year continuity
low-effort deals the sales director can close without the pricing committee
protects: unit_price (head-office freeze on reductions until Dec 2027; 'discounts not possible this year')
list price policy: any change above 2 % goes to the pricing committee

trades.give: contract_months up (extend the framework to 24–36 months, through 2028)
trades.get: unit_price held flat at 319.11 for the whole term, no index_clause
trades.why: A price hold fits the freeze, and its asks have always settled at 0 %. This locks that in beyond 2027.

trades.give: binding rolling forecast plus volume_per_year commitment (~1,330 pcs/yr)
trades.get: lead_time_days below 56 and contractual call-off flexibility or a buffer stock
trades.why: The sales director is explicitly open on call-off flexibility, and OTD has slipped to 95.8 %.

trades.give: a commitment to pay strictly on time (fixing our late payments)
trades.why: It is open on payment terms, and the extension does not touch list price.

trades.get: skonto of about 2 % as a payment term
trades.why: This captures value as a payment condition instead of a price reduction, which the freeze forbids. It is only worth it if our cost of money allows.

arguments.point: The 180-day deadline for price-change notice and termination before year-end 2026 has passed. The contract therefore runs to 2027-12-31 at the fixed annual price of 319.11, and it has quoted that price itself.
Our spend has grown from 317 k to 424 k and then 426 k EUR, so we are a growing, reliable A-class account worth securing long term.
OTD fell from 100 % to 95.8 %, just above the 95 % target. Ask for lead-time and call-off commitments to protect delivery.
We are asking for nothing that breaks the price freeze, only terms the sales director said he can move.

avoid: Demanding a unit_price reduction: it is blocked by head office until Dec 2027 and wastes goodwill.
Threatening to resource: there is no alternative source, the part needs ATEX and drinking-water approval, and we are only 0.2 % of its turnover.
Leaning on the should-cost gap (+16.6 %): the estimate has only 5 % confidence.
Pushing ppm or chargeback penalties: ppm is 0 and there have been no complaints in 12 months.
Asks that need the pricing committee unless necessary: keep requests within the sales director's authority to avoid delay.
tone: Professional, concise and policy-aware. Acknowledge the freeze, frame requests as terms and planning security, and avoid confrontation.
red_flags: Single source (100 % quota, 0 other sources) for a certified ATEX, drinking-water seal; requalification would be long.
OTD has slipped to 95.8 %, close to the 95 % contractual target.
We pay late 66 % of the time, which weakens our standing with a supplier that does not need us.
The next termination window is the 180-day notice before 2027-12-31; it could seek increases when the freeze ends in Dec 2027.

evidence.claim: Head office froze price reductions until Dec 2027; open on payment terms and call-off flexibility
Price changes above 2 % need pricing committee approval (meets every two weeks)
Current quote unchanged at 319.11; 'discounts not possible this year (head-office directive)'
Asked 3.3 %, 2.2 % and 1.3 % at the last three renewals; settled 0 % each time
Sole source, 100 % quota, ATEX and drinking-water approved part
Contract auto-extends 12 months; price fixed per calendar year with 180-day notice
Should-cost 273.72 vs price 319.11, but only 5 % confidence
Extending drinking-water approvals to further markets, so the business is healthy
